tools.name: plan_visit
tools.title: Plan the visit
tools.description: Seed a fresh simulated plan from visit facts (replaces current world in this process).

tools.name: apply_change
tools.title: Change visit facts
tools.description: Apply fact edits; returns the proposed change set. Nothing executes without confirm_ops on exact op ids.

tools.name: confirm_ops
tools.title: Approve operations
tools.description: Decide proposed ops by exact id. Optionally pass the payloadHash/factsVersion returned by apply_change to bind consent to the reviewed payload — a mismatch is rejected honestly. Stale/expired consent is rejected either way.

tools.name: decline_ops
tools.title: Decline operations
tools.description: Decide proposed ops by exact id. Optionally pass the payloadHash/factsVersion returned by apply_change to bind consent to the reviewed payload — a mismatch is rejected honestly. Stale/expired consent is rejected either way.

tools.name: get_receipt
tools.title: Causal receipt for a fact
tools.description: Ops and ledger events actually caused by a fact change (provenance-stamped).

tools.name: get_status
tools.title: Plan status
tools.description: Current commitments, lifecycle states, spend, open decisions.

tools.name: execute_approved
tools.title: Execute approved ops
tools.description: Execute every approved op in the open change set. Truthful outcomes: applied / rejected / requoted.
